what: The Fake Data Generator creates realistic test data: names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, companies, dates, UUIDs, numbers and more, for 16 countries and languages.

All of it is made up from built-in word lists. Emails use the reserved example.com, example.org and example.net domains, and US and UK phone numbers use ranges set aside for fiction. Data is generated in your browser and can be downloaded as CSV, JSON, JSON Lines or SQL INSERT statements.
uses: Fill forms, lists and databases with realistic data while developing.
Show a product with believable data instead of real customers.
Create sample tables for teaching Excel, SQL or data analysis.
Test how your app handles accents, Cyrillic, Arabic, Chinese and Japanese names.
Make thousands of rows to import in one go.
tutorial: Choose a country or language for names, cities, address and phone formats, or Mixed for all. The list starts with your browser language when it is one of them.
Each row is a column: choose the type and edit the column name. Add up to 40 columns or remove ones you do not need.
Set Rows (up to 10,000) and pick CSV, JSON, JSON Lines or SQL INSERT. For SQL, set the table name.
Enter a seed like 42 to get exactly the same data every time.
Press Generate and check the preview of the first rows.
Press Copy or Download. CSV files open directly in Excel with accents intact.
features: United States, United Kingdom, India, Spain, Mexico, France, Germany, Italy, Brazil, Netherlands, Türkiye, Indonesia, Russia, Egypt, Japan and China.
Each row is one made-up person, so the name, email and username match, and age matches the birth date.
From UUIDs and passwords to IPv6 documentation addresses, hex colours and coordinates.
CSV with BOM for Excel, pretty JSON, JSON Lines and batched SQL INSERT statements.
A seed gives the same data every time.
Reserved email domains and documentation IP ranges, nothing taken from real people.

example.title: Test users for a signup page
example.text: Choose English (United Kingdom), keep the default columns, set Rows to 500 and Format to SQL INSERT with table users. Press Generate and download fake-data.sql: 500 users such as Oscar Moore, oscarm29@example.net, phone 07700 900388, ready to import into your test database.

tips: Use Mixed to test how your app handles many scripts at once.
Keep a seed in your test scripts so everyone gets the same data.
For very large data sets, generate several batches with different seeds.
Rename columns to match your database before generating SQL.
problems: Every column needs its own name. Change one of them.
Open the CSV by double-clicking it, or use Data > From Text/CSV and choose UTF-8.
Outside the US and UK there are no reserved fictional ranges, so numbers are random. Never call or message them.
